headline: Prices likely rise in Q4. Confidence is stronger in DRAM than NAND.
scope: Quarter-on-quarter sector contract prices. Company blended ASP, HBM mix, spot chips and customs USD/kg have different bases.
method: Confidence labels are qualitative judgments, not calibrated probabilities. Historical same-quarter tests support signal selection; they do not establish a quarter-ahead forecast hit rate.

products.why: September BOK and October DDR5 support higher Q4 contracts. Hynix Q3 actuals and Barclays / JPM post-results commentary reinforce the direction; repeated readings of the same result are not independent price observations.
products.limit: DDR4 spot is softer. Morgan Stanley (28 Oct) says price hikes are moderating. No basis to select +10-15% versus nearly +20%, or upgrade confidence before October BOK and fresh company disclosures.

products.focus: Contracts; strongest case in enterprise SSD
products.why: The industry contract outlook remains positive, with enterprise SSD the clearest area of strength. The independent price signals are mixed.
products.limit: September BOK flash declined and October TLC 512Gb / 1Tb spot weakened. Broad acceleration is not confirmed.
products.magnitude_confidence: Low for broad +15–20% realization or company blended ASP

signal_rows.dram: September +2.3% MoM; Q3 +14.8% QoQ. Positive entry momentum.
signal_rows.nand: September −0.7% MoM; Q3 +19.0% QoQ. Strong quarter, softer exit.
signal_rows.weight: Main observed price anchor. Wait for October to assess Q4; September is Q3 evidence.

signal_rows.date: Through 29 Oct 2026; 18 observations per series; versus September mean
signal_rows.weight: Useful short-horizon cross-check. Incomplete month and narrow specifications; not a sector contract forecast.

signal_rows.nand: Flash USD/kg −22.0%; Flash + SSD Törnqvist index −3.8% MoM.
signal_rows.weight: Composition warning. USD/kg mixes price, density and product mix; the composition index also retains within-category mix. Neither is a fixed-specification price.

signal_rows.dram: High-20s ASP increase in Q3 supports the strong realized backdrop.
signal_rows.nand: Mid-20s ASP increase in Q3 supports the strong realized backdrop.
signal_rows.weight: Realized company ASP is Q3 evidence. It does not establish a numerical Q4 price guide.
signal_rows.source: SK hynix Q3 2026 earnings materials, 28 Oct 2026

signal_rows.signal: Samsung Q3 released; numerical ASP pending primary verification
signal_rows.dram: Jefferies / Conor O’Mara relays Q3 ASP +20% QoQ; secondary call notes.
signal_rows.nand: Same notes relay high-teens% QoQ; secondary evidence.
signal_rows.weight: Official presentation confirms Q3 price increases across applications and continued Q4 AI/server demand, but does not quantify ASP. Q2 remains the latest primary-verified numeric fit target; no Q4 ASP guide inferred.

signal_rows.date: Calendar Q2 2026 = FY26 Q1; call 31 Jul; checked 28 Oct

signal_rows.weight: Historical backdrop, not Q4. Transcript passage does not explicitly identify ASP currency: no USD comparison inferred. FY26 Q2 results scheduled 30 Oct, 18:45 JST.

street_rows.name: TrendForce → J.P. Morgan
street_rows.byline: TrendForce 30 Sep; Joseph Cardoso, Manmohanpreet Singh and Marc Vitenzon relay, 26 Oct 2026
street_rows.nand: +15–20% QoQ NAND contracts; enterprise SSD expected to accelerate
street_rows.assessment: Directionally aligned on both. DRAM has stronger corroboration. NAND’s sector range is not independently validated by the mixed spot/BOK readings.

street_rows.name: Jefferies expert call · Harald Lee
street_rows.byline: Call 22 Oct; Conor O’Mara notes 28 Oct 2026
street_rows.nand: No numerical Q4 NAND forecast in the reviewed notes
street_rows.assessment: A bullish DRAM scenario with low–moderate confidence in the magnitude. The expert’s more muted NAND outlook / possible 2H27 balance is a different horizon.

street_rows.name: Barclays
street_rows.byline: Simon Coles, Bernd Klanten, Thomas Wu · 28 Oct 2026
street_rows.dram: Pricing tailwinds for at least another couple of quarters; conventional DRAM strength.
street_rows.nand: No numerical Q4 NAND ASP forecast in reviewed email.
street_rows.assessment: Supports direction, not a new realized Q4 observation or calibrated magnitude.

street_rows.name: Morgan Stanley
street_rows.byline: Shawn Kim, Ryan Kim, Cindy Huang, Kathy Zhu · 28 Oct 2026
street_rows.dram: Better pricing/mix, but memory price hikes moderating.
street_rows.nand: No numerical Q4 NAND ASP forecast in reviewed email.
street_rows.assessment: Counterweight to extrapolating Q3: slowing increases are compatible with rising prices. Q4 bit growth is volume, not ASP.

street_rows.name: J.P. Morgan
street_rows.byline: Jay Kwon / Sangsik Lee · 28 Oct 2026 post-results update
street_rows.dram: HBM mix / pricing and supply visibility support the cycle.
street_rows.nand: No numerical Q4 NAND ASP forecast in reviewed email.
street_rows.assessment: Forecast upgrades mainly concern 2027-28 HBM and margins; do not translate into a higher Q4 conventional price forecast.

street_rows.name: J.P. Morgan · Samsung post-results
street_rows.dram: Continued shortages despite above-seasonal Q4 bit growth.
street_rows.nand: Faster bit supply; no numerical Q4 NAND ASP forecast in reviewed email.
street_rows.assessment: Supply acceleration is a caution, not proof of oversupply. Q4 bit growth is volume, not price; 2027 HBM ASP estimates use a different horizon and product.

street_rows.name: Morgan Stanley · Samsung post-results
street_rows.byline: Shawn Kim / Ryan Kim / Cindy Huang / Kathy Zhu · 29 Oct 2026
street_rows.dram: Memory price hikes moderating into late cycle.
street_rows.nand: AI / QLC SSD demand supports further growth; no numerical Q4 NAND ASP forecast in reviewed email.
street_rows.assessment: Reinforces restraint on magnitude. Samsung result corroborates the existing up call, but is Q3 evidence; no confidence upgrade.

watch.status: Samsung Q3 released 29 Oct; await numeric primary ASP script and October BOK / contracts
watch.strengthen: October BOK DRAM stays positive and actual contract increases broaden across server DDR5, PC and mobile. Persistent DDR5 spot strength adds corroboration. Samsung confirms Q3 price breadth; require Q4 realized pricing corroboration, beyond HBM mix, before upgrading.
watch.weaken: Persistent DDR5 spot weakness together with declining BOK DRAM and flat or falling contract realizations would move the view toward neutral. Evidence of a lower Q4 contract average would overturn the up call.
watch.alone: A weak DDR4 spot print or a customs USD/kg decline alone is insufficient.

watch.status: Kioxia 30 Oct pending; Samsung Q3 supports backlog, but BOK / spot breadth still matters
watch.strengthen: BOK flash returns to growth, 512Gb / 1Tb spot joins the 256Gb recovery, and enterprise SSD contract increases are confirmed. Broader participation would raise confidence. Kioxia like-for-like ASP / forward pricing commentary on 30 Oct matters more than revenue or blended mix alone.
watch.weaken: Continued weakness in 512Gb / 1Tb spot together with another BOK flash decline and weak contract realizations would reduce confidence. A lower Q4 sector contract average would overturn the up call.
watch.alone: Strong broad semiconductor export value or a rise in 256Gb spot alone does not confirm the sector range.

decision_rule: These are evidence combinations for a research review, not automatic trading thresholds. A monthly decline can coexist with a higher quarterly average. Reassess breadth, magnitude and direction separately.
history_note: Complete-quarter, lag-0 SK hynix ASP tests on the 28 October data vintage. Chronological estimation; historical release timestamps are not fully reconstructed. These are contemporaneous classifications, not advance-warning probabilities.
history_conclusion: BOK is more informative than raw customs unit values in this sample. Its regression beats prior-quarter ASP persistence but not direct BOK growth. Recent-period errors are larger, especially for NAND; the extra history does not justify a precise Q4 ASP forecast.

changelog.change: Initial dated Q4 board. Adds the existing research reading without replacing the frozen earnings refit or historical calculation audit.

28 Oct evening company / sell-side review: Hynix Q3 ASP confirmed; Samsung and Kioxia latest verified actuals remain calendar Q2. Added Barclays, Morgan Stanley and JPM post-results commentary. DRAM Up / Moderate-high and NAND Up selectively / Moderate unchanged; no new numeric Q4 company ASP guide established. Prior judgment archived.

Samsung 29 Oct official presentation confirms Q3 price increases across applications and Q4 AI/server demand. Jefferies call notes relay Q3 DRAM +20% / NAND high teens; official numeric script unavailable (404), so these remain secondary evidence outside regression targets. JPM flags faster supply but continued shortage; MS repeats moderating price hikes. Direction and confidence unchanged. Refreshed quantitative signals checked separately. October29 spot retains the same split: DDR5 up, DDR4 and larger-density NAND down. All seven BOK series still end September; no October DRAM/flash observation. No new candidate alert.
